title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Whether the People's Court Shall Permit a Defendant Who Has Filed an Appeal Against a Death Sentence to Withdraw the Appeal After the Appeal Period Expires but Before the Judgment Is Pronounced

articles.content_en:
August 6, 2010
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate
Reply on Whether a People's Court Shall Permit a Defendant Who Has Appealed a Death Sentence to Withdraw the Appeal After the Appeal Period but Before the Judgment Pronouncement
Fa Shi [2010] No. 10
To the Higher People's Courts and People's Procuratorates of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court and Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region and the People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:
Recently, some Higher People's Courts and provincial People's Procuratorates have requested instructions on whether to permit withdrawal of an appeal where a defendant sentenced to immediate execution of death penalty in the first instance appeals and then requests withdrawal of the appeal during the second instance trial. Upon examination, the reply is as follows:
Where a defendant sentenced to immediate execution of death penalty in the first instance appeals and applies for withdrawal of the appeal after the appeal period expires but before the second instance trial commences, the matter shall be handled in accordance with Article 4 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Procedures for Open Trial of Second Instance Death Penalty Cases (for Trial Implementation). Where the application for withdrawal of the appeal is made after the second instance trial commences but before the judgment is announced, the second instance People's Court shall not permit the withdrawal of the appeal and shall continue the trial in accordance with the appeal procedures.
Where any judicial interpretation or normative document previously issued by the Supreme People's Court or the Supreme People's Procuratorate is inconsistent with this Reply, this Reply shall prevail.
